s2.name: dev:logit_v1_s2v2
s2.note: development stand-in: westside v̂ = the logit_v1_s2v2 (GEO_V1) volume head design refit per season set on its own rows; central and south p = the served logit_v1 recipe (19 features + hinges, C 0.03) with every weight ≥ 0, refit on SFPUC4 ledger-known days with the outage-masked rain. Its C was chosen on pre-holdout leave-one-season-out and its hinges have unrecorded provenance, so every T2 score read through it is development (selection-contaminated; protocol §2). The assemble step swaps in the S2 bake-off winner.

note: Westside's two links share its overflow by s(v̂) = logistic(a + b·log1p v̂), v̂ the basin size predicted from rain, fit on v̂ out of sample (inner leave-one-season-out); the other links are identity; East is the union of Central and South by the rule chosen nested on chained East Brier.

window.top: T1 final: fit on every day through 2025-10-31
window.T2: refit per held-out season on the other eight of 2016-17 … 2024-25

fit.v_hat: a fit day's v̂ is the fold's head design refit without that day's season (inner leave-one-season-out); a scored day's v̂ is the fold's head (Part B 2: shares fit on v̂ the same way they are used)
fit.fit_rows: the S3 oracle's scored rows of the split zones on the fold's training days (X-S3-UNCOV, X-LEDGER-SUSPECT, X-S3-CARRY, X-S3-QUIET)
fit.union_choice: per fold, on East Brier (rain known) pooled over inner leave-one-season-out on its T2 seasons: the default max stays unless a challenger is better (the 90% storm-block CI of Δ = BS(challenger) − BS(max) wholly below 0, B = 2000, seed 0); between two better challengers whose difference's CI includes 0, the one with fewer parameters

s3b.comparison: S3b: BS(logit_logvol) − BS(constant), S3 oracle (true occurrence, v̂ from rain), T2, both Westside zones
s3b.how: Holm over S3a and S3b at one-sided α = 0.05: the smaller p is tested at 0.025 (the 95% CI's upper bound below 0 for a superiority claim), the larger at 0.05 (the 90% CI's); p_one_sided = P*(Δ* ≥ 0).
